action:
After a standard system update you need to restart any running Java
applications to make all the necessary changes.
description:
USN-9004-1 fixed vulnerabilities in OpenJDK 25. Unfortunately, the fix
included an unnecessary debuginfo file. This update fixes the problem.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

Original advisory details:

 authenticate users. A remote attacker could possibly use this issue to
 cause a denial of service or to read or modify sensitive data.
 (CVE-2026-91415)
